title: PIPESHARE landing About + brand visuals
description:
pipeshare.net homepage keeps the existing business/customer sign-in and brochure cards, and adds a short About section plus stylized industrial brand images (hero pipe visual, AutoSync feature art, About banner). Copy covers what PIPESHARE is, who it is for, and the problems it solves.

Who is affected: visitors on pipeshare.net (and the same marketing path on pipeshare.live). Login cards and auth flow are unchanged.
changeLog: Added About section and brand images on the SaaS marketing landing.
Header About / Sign in jump links; login cards unchanged.
Hero, AutoSync, and About visuals under marketing/pipeshare/assets/.
